ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

3. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

4. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

6. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the library

7. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. Only a joining word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only a describing word

8. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

10. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. going

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

12. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.

13. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
